_comment: Twenty questions, each requiring exactly one of two tools. Frozen so a later run measures the same thing and the numbers are comparable. Ten per tool, deliberately balanced: a model that always picks the first tool scores 10/20 on 'correct tool' rather than accidentally passing.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the repository and return its contents.

path.description: path relative to the repository root

function.name: run_tests
function.description: Run the project's test suite, optionally filtered to matching test names.

filter.description: substring of the test names to run

system: You have tools. Use them rather than describing what you would do. Reply with a tool call, not prose.
